protocol.climate_policy: forecast-only typical spring background of training years; not long-term climate normals; no observed temperature,cold labels,validation or control seasons in descriptors
protocol.terrain_policy: GFS HGT surface f010 from same object/version/grid as nightly temperature, each night; no assumed universal lapse rate
protocol.selection: each prior year: primary all/cold MAE,point crossing FA/misses <= legacy; regional macro site all/cold MAE,point crossing FA/misses <= GFS; rank primary cold MAE then all MAE; fallback legacy
protocol.spatial_policy: previously viewed two heldout sites; no labels in selection/fit/profiles; their training-year forecast-only background permitted only after choice for transfer test
protocol.detector_policy: original point and detector artifacts/masks/timing kept; no new operational alerts or field forecast
protocol.unknown_site_policy: requires verified metadata and prior forecast-only context; matched models blend trained experts by fixed context distance, no fitting on unknown site observations
